name: Approvals and Feedback Loop
description: An admin logs in, navigates to the Approvals view, requests a revision for QA E2E Content Title, submits revision instructions, and checks that the instructions are recorded.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the application login page
If a warning, reminder, or interstitial page appears with a button to continue (such as Click to Continue or Continue to Site), click that button to proceed to the application
Enter admin@quantira.com into the email address input field
Enter admin123 into the password input field
Click the Approvals sidebar navigation link
Verify that an approval card containing the text QA E2E Content Title is visible
Click the Request Revision button on the card for QA E2E Content Title
Type Needs CTA link fixes and font check. into the revision instructions feedback text area input field
Click the Send Instructions submission button
Click the Expand details button on the card for QA E2E Content Title
Verify that a feedback list or badge is visible containing the text Needs CTA link fixes
